proofBoundary.gate: Executes actual inline workflow Bash with explicit job/step inputs; does not simulate GitHub orchestration.
proofBoundary.matrix: Disposable Git repository using the actual workspace manifests, lockfile, Turbo configuration and runner; task bodies replaced with execution markers. Real workspace tests are verified separately.
proofBoundary.cache: All configured tasks uncached; remote caching disabled; no database or mutation is performed by these marker probes.
proofBoundary.application: Actual workflow Test command with real workspace suites; full selection because this branch changes shared/root inputs.
proofBoundary.database: DB command bodies unchanged since Step 2; not rerun for this metadata-only step. Full combined run remains Step 4.
